explicitly_excluded: all biological records except first CSV header row
safe_access: Parse the version-pinned file listing for exact Dryad-issued per-file download API paths; do not invent or search a new URL. One GET per declared file, no retries. Publisher SHA256 must match before inspecting even headers.

report.csv: exact header column names only, number of header fields; no event rows or row counts
report.readme: string terms and presence flags only; if useful, bounded sentence-level descriptions not full copyrighted README
report.classification: presence of column *names* consistent with source patch/destination patch/year/assignment; cannot establish values, agreement with old study, provenance or direction
report.output: aggregate-only JSON with raw file SHA-256 and receipt digest; zero data rows, movement estimates or gene IDs

stop_rules: No silent file version selection, URI substitution or post-outcome threshold changes
